# ZZZ positions that 3.0 extracts and the 2.x native projection did not. Each group
# was checked by hand against the sample file: all are real comments or docstrings.
#
# Python. 2.x blanked docstrings as strings. 3.0 extracts the string that opens a module,
# class or function body: the module docstring, the function docstring and the class
# docstring in the sample. The ordinary strings in the sample stay unread.
sample.py 2 11
sample.py 4 8
sample.py 12 17
sample.py 19 14
sample.py 20 15
# Lua. 2.x had no `--` marker for Lua, so it kept no Lua comment.
sample.lua 1 4
sample.lua 2 26
sample.lua 3 6
sample.lua 4 1
# Rust. The lifetime in `&'static str` opened a quote in the 2.x projection and it
# blanked the rest of the file, so it lost these genuine comments.
sample.rs 5 8
sample.rs 6 44
sample.rs 7 10
sample.rs 11 4
sample.rs 12 4
sample.rs 14 5
# Clojure. 2.x used `#` as the Clojure line marker, so it kept no `;` comment.
sample.clj 1 3
sample.clj 2 22
sample.clj 3 14
